summary: In this excerpt from a fiction novel ("Book 2 — part 189"), the narrator Cas confronts Rio in a darkened subway tunnel about why he traded her safety for Dawna's, why he didn't kill her earlier when he could have gained Dawna's trust, and what he is hiding. Rio refuses to explain and walks away, leaving Cas frustrated. Cas then climbs to the platform for a final meeting, where she finds Steve at an empty construction site, looking exhausted and haggard.
one_line: Cas confronts Rio in a dark subway tunnel over his secret motives and protective behavior, then meets a haggard Steve at a construction site.
key_facts: Rio traded Cas's safety for Dawna's, and Cas says this was not the first time he did so.
Back when Dawna had Arthur and Cas, Rio was trying to take down Pithica and had the perfect opportunity to kill Cas and secure Dawna's trust.
Cas says Rio could have killed her, secured Dawna's trust, and destroyed them from the inside out, but instead he broke them out.
Dawna Polk called Cas an anomaly, and Cas found it bothersome that Dawna seemed to understand Rio's relationship with Cas better than she did.
Rio said, "I had other considerations. You were not aware of them."
Rio told Cas, "I'm not going to answer your questions. I advise you to stop asking them."
Rio tipped his hat to Cas and walked away down the darkened subway tracks.
Cas says that at the beginning Rio told her not to get involved, and he said it was because he didn't want her involved.
Cas shouted after Rio, "I don't like things that don't make sense!"
Cas had one more meeting that day, which she hoped would be more satisfactory than the meeting with Rio.
Steve met Cas at an empty construction site.
Steve had several days' worth of five o'clock shadow on his square jaw and deep purple shadows under his eyes.
